retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 1980s-style collage featuring a central scalloped-edge photo frame, bold yellow script typography, and a dense list of credits flanking the main imagery.
triggerTerms: yellow script title on blue background

recipe.visualDefinition: A busy, nostalgic composition characterized by a central irregular photo cutout with a white scalloped border, set against a textured blue background. The layout is dominated by a large, fluid yellow script title at the top and symmetrical columns of sans-serif text on the left and right sides.
coreVisualRelationships: Large yellow script title overlapping the top of a central photo frame
White scalloped border separating the central collage from the blue background
Symmetrical columns of white and orange text flanking the central image
High-contrast color interaction between bright yellow, red accents, and cyan-blue
coreInvariants: White scalloped or 'cloud-like' border around the central image area
Fluid, connected script for the primary display text
Textured blue background with a subtle halftone or paper grain

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A multi-figure collage occupies the center, framed by a white border that takes up approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow script title at the top center acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top title down into the central character faces, then outward to the list of names on the left and right margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the blue background serves as a frame rather than open space, filled with secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan-blue background with a textured finish.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary title and secondary highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red for small banners and orange for secondary text details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value, creating a sunny, energetic 1950s-revival-in-the-80s feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, upright script with thick strokes and rounded terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Letters are connected with smooth ligatures
Red drop shadow or thick outline to separate from background
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' and 'S' characters feature large, sweeping curves that frame the rest of the word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A flamboyant, organic script paired with rigid, functional condensed sans-serifs for information density.
graphicDevices: Angled yellow banner with red text

candidateDirections.reason: Similar weight and fluid connection for the display title.
Matches the blocky, high-density feel of the side lists.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cyan-blue textured background with a subtle halftone pattern. In the center, place a large white shape with a scalloped, cloud-like edge containing a collage of people in a sunny, 1980s beach setting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold yellow script title at the top with a red outline. Place two columns of condensed sans-serif text on the left and right sides of the blue background, alternating between white and orange colors.

verificationChecks: Is the title in a thick yellow script?
Does the central image have a white scalloped border?
Is the background a textured cyan-blue?
Are there dense columns of text on the sides?

mustRedesign: Specific faces and people in the collage
Specific song titles and artist names

avoid: Clean, flat vector backgrounds without texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script title is the largest element.
Verify the white border is distinctly scalloped.
Check that the blue background has a visible texture or grain.
Confirm the side text is organized into clear vertical columns.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured cyan field with a scalloped central photo window, topped by a heavy yellow script and flanked by condensed sans-serif lists.
